_comment: Backend catalogue inputs for the existing Pedidos billing implementation.
Recovered from tag v0.196.0, commit 76d7ab50653dde26089c3f620233172e8856e1b1, apps/rocoto/product/pricing.json.
All data values are preserved. Historical explanatory comments remain in that Git source.
This input supports provisioning and offline checks; runtime billing continues to use brain/pedidos_billing.py.
Historical live/sellable flags and customer copy describe this implementation, not current product readiness or a new offer.
Release readiness: ../docs/ENGINEERING-READINESS.md. See backend/README.md for ownership and validation.
